sources: Tyranid 2.pdf p3 — Talons of the Norn Queen
Tyranid 2.pdf p19 — Rules updates (Synapse, Shadow, Crusher clarifications)

synapse.title: Synapse
synapse.summary: Within 6" of friendly SYNAPSE models = within Synapse Range.

shadowInTheWarp.title: Shadow in the Warp
shadowInTheWarp.summary: Once per battle, either player's Command phase (Tyranids units with this ability on the board).
effects: Each enemy unit on the battlefield takes a Battle-shock test.
If within 6" of your SYNAPSE units: -1 to that test.

detachments.name: Crusher Stampede

detachmentRule.name: Enraged Behemoths
detachmentRule.text: Each time a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army makes an attack:
bullets: +1 to Hit if its unit is below Starting Strength.
+1 to Wound as well if its unit is Below Half-strength.
While a TYRANIDS MONSTER unit (not Battle-shocked) is at Starting Strength: +2 OC to models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Enraged Reserves
enhancements.effect: If destroyed by a melee attack before fighting: on 3+, fight after attackers then remove.

enhancements.name: Null Nodules
enhancements.effect: Once/battle when allocated a Psychic Attack: FNP 5+ vs Psychic Attacks until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Corrosive Viscera
stratagems.when: Opp. Shooting or Fight, after a non-FLY TYRANIDS MONSTER with Deadly Demise is destroyed.

stratagems.name: Rampaging Monstrosities
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit not yet fought.

stratagems.name: Savage Roar
stratagems.when: Fight, after enemy selects targets vs your MONSTER.
stratagems.effect: Enemy Battle-shock test; until end of phase -1 Hit vs your unit (-1 Wound too if failed).

stratagems.name: Untrammelled Ferocity
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit not yet moved.
stratagems.effect: Move through non-TITANIC models & terrain ≤4"; may cross taller terrain (after move, D6: 1 = Battle-shocked). Cannot end in Engagement Range.

stratagems.name: Swarm-Guided Salvoes
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit not yet shot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged [IGNORES COVER]; ignore BS and Hit roll modifiers.

stratagems.name: Massive Impact
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, after MONSTER ends Charge.
stratagems.effect: One enemy in Engagement Range: roll 6D6, each 4+ = 1 MW.

notes: Rules update confirms Enraged Behemoths and Untrammelled Ferocity wording (Tyranid 2.pdf p19).

detachmentRule.name: Higher Imperatives
detachmentRule.text: Friendly NORN EMISSARY and NORN ASSIMILATOR units:
bullets: Protean Purpose (once per battle, per unit): In your Command phase, re-select Singular Purpose (replaces previous choice).

stratagems.name: Catalytic Biofortification
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a NORN ASSIMILATOR suffers a mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Lesser Prey
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when NORN ASSIMILATOR or NORN EMISSARY selected to fight.

stratagems.name: Tanglestrike Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after NORN ASSIMILATOR has shot.
stratagems.effect: One enemy unit hit is Tethered until start of your next Command phase (-2" Move).

reference.title: Singular Purpose (Norn Emissary / Assimilator)
bullets: Command phase: select one objective marker or one enemy unit.
Objective: while in range, FNP 4+ and OC 15.
Enemy unit: re-roll Hit and Wound vs that unit until your next Command phase.

sporeMines.title: Spore Mines (11th Edition)
sporeMines.summary: Destroyed immediately when an enemy unit ends a move within 3". Triggered by proximity — not by damage.
bullets: Movement: Enemy ends a move within 3" → mine explodes and is removed.
Shooting: Cannot shoot Spore Mines; can shoot units in contact with them.
Explosion (per mine): D6 — 1 = nothing; 2–5 = 1 MW; 6 = D3 MW to nearest enemy unit.
OC 0 — cannot hold objectives or complete secondaries themselves.
Use for area denial / force MWs on approach; Behind Enemy Lines via Biovore or Sporocyst into opponent DZ.

terrainRules.title: Terrain Rules
terrainRules.summary: To count as being within terrain: A model must be at least partially in the terrain.

sections.heading: Movement in terrain:
bullets: Exposed/Light terrain can be moved through freely, but you cannot end on top of the terrain.
Dense terrain can be moved though only by inf, beasts, and swarm models.
Flying models pay a 2" penalty for moving over any terrain.
Mobile" keyword allows units to ignore terrain.

sections.heading: Shooting and terrain:
bullets: Obscuring: If every line of sight is drawn completely through both light or dense terrain then the models are not visible to each other.
Model within the terrain can have line of sight, but not through dense terrain.
Hidden: Infantry, beast, or swarm is within terrain, they are unable to be targeted outside of 15 inches, as long as the unit did not fire a range weapon this turn or last turn.
Cover: If all infantry, beast, or swarm unit models are within the terrain, they gain cover. -1 BS.
Cover: Enemy units that are not fully visible also gain cover, -1 BS.
